record.original_question: For every graph G of order n and every k in {1, 2, ..., n}, must the sum S_k(G) of the k largest Laplacian eigenvalues satisfy S_k(G) <= e(G) + binom(k+1, 2)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 16 (Brouwer’s conjecture [31]). Let G be a graph of order n. Then S_k(G) ≤ e(G) + (k + 1 choose 2), k = 1, 2, . . . , n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite simple graph on $n$ vertices with $e(G)=|E|$ edges. Let $L(G)=D(G)-A(G)$ denote the Laplacian matrix of $G$, where $A(G)$ is the adjacency matrix and $D(G)$ is the diagonal matrix of vertex degrees. Let $\mu_1(G)\ge \mu_2(G)\ge \cdots \ge \mu_n(G)=0$ be the eigenvalues of $L(G)$, and define
$$S_k(G)=\sum_{i=1}^{k}\mu_i(G), \qquad k=1,2,\dots,n.$$
Determine whether, for every graph $G$ of order $n$ and every integer $k\in\{1,2,\dots,n\}$, the inequality
$$S_k(G)\;\le\;e(G)+\binom{k+1}{2}$$
holds.
artifact.status_search_result: Brouwer's conjecture remains open in general as of 2025–2026. It is known to hold for several classes (trees, unicyclic, bicyclic graphs, certain c-cyclic constructions, graphs with n ≥ 4Δ², and split-graph related families), and approximate versions have been established, but no proof or counterexample for arbitrary graphs is known.

status_evidence.title: Brouwer's conjecture - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The conjecture has been verified for several classes of graphs including trees, unicyclic and bicyclic graphs; the general case remains open.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is still open in general but verified for several graph families.

status_evidence.title: Remarks on the Brouwer Conjecture (arXiv 2508.07550)
status_evidence.snippet: The conjecture holds for all graphs with n vertices if n ≥ 4Δ² where Δ is the maximum degree.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial result confirming the conjecture under a degree/order condition.

status_evidence.title: An approximate version of Brouwer's Laplacian conjecture (arXiv 2601.17575)
status_evidence.snippet: Approximate version of Brouwer's conjecture established.
status_evidence.claim: Approximate version proven; full conjecture still open.

status_evidence.title: More on the full Brouwer Laplacian spectrum conjecture (arXiv 2503.11165)
status_evidence.snippet: Verifies the full Brouwer conjecture for additional families.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing progress on special cases, indicating the general conjecture is unresolved.
